uncertainty: The county CivicPlus pages returned a Cloudflare 403 to direct GET during this attempt; search-indexed official content and the county GIS download host remained available. No CAPTCHA or bypass was attempted.
The San Ramon-hosted ArcGIS parcel service metadata identified Contra Costa Assessor as its source, but bounded Antioch queries returned empty; it was not used for the retained sample.
The three polygons are a bounded evidence sample, not a citywide completeness claim or runtime integration admission.
